That is a small sign of deference to the election commission rather than direct executive interference.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"PBBM declares free, safe environment for journalists under Bagong Pilipinas","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-04-15","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-declares-free-safe-environment-for-journalists-under-bagong-pilipinas/","summary":"Marcos publicly pledged a free and safe environment for journalists and said critical press is better than a compliant press. This is not proof of practice, but it cuts against overt media capture rhetoric.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.8","3B.3"]},{"title":"Gov’t vows legal action vs deep fake video creators, spreaders","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/govt-vows-legal-action-vs-deep-fake-video-creators-spreaders/","summary":"After a deepfake video, the government said DICT and the NSC were investigating and considering legal action. That is a reactive legal response, not a censorship or emergency-power sweep.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.6"]},{"title":"Philippine News Agency article 1217036","publisher":"Philippine News Agency","date":"2024-01-18","url":"https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1217036","summary":"The administration expanded eFOI access and kept a media-literacy / disinformation campaign in place. That supports a limited transparency posture rather than outright information closure.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.6","3B.8"]},{"title":"PCO to designate fact-check officers in state media to fight fake news","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-09-09","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pco-to-designate-fact-check-officers-in-state-media-to-fight-fake-news/","summary":"PCO said it would place fact-check officers in state media and denied any policy or practice of red-tagging in the Marcos administration. This is a real formal anti-disinformation step, though not a full safeguard against abuse.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.3","3B.8"]},{"title":"PBBM signs laws on streamlining procurement, combatting online scams","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-07-20","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/","summary":"Marcos pushed procurement reform to shorten timelines, standardize forms, and institutionalize e-procurement. That is evidence against using public resources primarily as a personal patronage machine.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.10"]},{"title":"Executive Order No. 81, s. 2024","publisher":"Lawphil / Office of the President","date":"2024-12-30","url":"https://lawphil.net/executive/execord/eo2024/eo_81_2024.html","summary":"Marcos reorganized the National Security Council to make it a more resilient institution and improve coordination. The structure is institutional rather than purely loyalist, though it still centralizes presidential discretion.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.9","3B.10"]},{"title":"Philippines: Freedom in the World 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/philippines/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says Philippine elections are free from overt restrictions but not fully fair because disinformation and vote buying distort competition; it also says red-tagging persisted under Marcos. This is the strongest broad external warning against clean non-entrenchment.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.3","3B.8"]},{"title":"Philippines: Red-tagging puts activists at risk","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/philippines-red-tagging-puts-activists-risk","summary":"HRW said red-tagging under Marcos placed leftist activists and critics at serious risk, with officials and supporters accusing them of communist ties. That is consistent with intimidation of opposition space rather than neutral competition.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.3","3B.8"]},{"title":"Philippines: Dangerous red-tagging of labor leaders","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-09-25","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/25/philippines-dangerous-red-tagging-labor-leaders","summary":"HRW reported Marcos-era officials and police or military members repeatedly visited union leaders and threatened them by linking them to communism. This is direct evidence of coercive pressure on civic organization.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.7"]},{"title":"Philippines: Human rights situation","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/asa35/8574/2024/en/","summary":"Amnesty says Marcos-era actors weaponized digital tools, misinformation, and the anti-terror law to create fear, and that red-tagging vilified activists, journalists, teachers, and others. That indicates a coercive information environment that can advantage incumbents.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.3","3B.8"]},{"title":"Philippines 2024 Human Rights Report","publisher":"U.S. State Department via ecoi.net","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128580.html","summary":"The U.S. State Department report says credible killings, disappearances, torture, arbitrary detention, media restrictions, and threats to labor activists remained. That is not consistent with a fully neutral, non-entrenching governing environment.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.10","3B.8","3B.1"]}]}
